title.zh: 多结果接合的共同关系结构
title.en: Common relational structure for multivalued joining

claim.zh: 有限结果接合的两份精确约简分支说明具有唯一的已用代码对齐，保持所有可能输出类；代码结果可从任意原来指定的同码输入对提升。
claim.en: Two exact reduced branch accounts of finite-outcome joining have a unique alignment on used codes preserving all possible outcome classes; each code outcome lifts from any originally specified input pair with those codes.

hypotheses.zh: 同一部分接合 J；每对输入具有有限结果集合。
hypotheses.en: One partial joining relation J; each input pair has a finite outcome set.

hypotheses.zh: 目标含全部有限否定、合取、左右接合后继问题，无独立原子谓词。
hypotheses.en: The target contains all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions, with no independent atomic predicates.

hypotheses.zh: Exact 给出完整精确答案；Reduced 仅用于最小代码与输出代码的提升。
hypotheses.en: Exact supplies complete truthful answers; Reduced is used for minimal codes and lifting output codes.

correspondence.zh: 片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。
correspondence.en: Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

detail.zh: 检查过的同一接合到模态模型适配。
detail.en: Checked adapter from the same joining to the modal model.

output.zh: same_iff_bisimilar 所用的 same_is_bisimulation：Same 本身构成 Bisimulation。
output.en: same_is_bisimulation, the checked core used by same_iff_bisimilar: Same itself forms a Bisimulation.

input.zh: branch_same_compatible 经 bisimulation_iff_compatible 接到左右接合，join_result_matches 再替换两个输入。
input.en: branch_same_compatible connects it to left/right joining via bisimulation_iff_compatible; join_result_matches then replaces both inputs.

conditions.zh: finite_outcomes_image_finite 验证有限纤维；无原子谓词；精确性及约简性另明示。
conditions.en: finite_outcomes_image_finite verifies finite fibers; no atomic predicates; exactness and reducedness are separately explicit.

detail.zh: 从单值共同操作接续到多结果关系；并非相同问题集下的无代价弱化。
detail.en: Continues from functional common operations to a multivalued relation, not a cost-free weakening for the identical question family.

detail.zh: 不同载体的保留引用形成对应已在新范围内实查；不是回写本结果的证明范围。
detail.en: Retained-reference formation across different carriers is checked at its new scope; it does not rewrite this result’s proof scope.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 有限结果和丰富问答仍是前提；保持结果类而非每个原生三元事实。例子证明共同关系仍可多结果。任意解释的适用性及不同分节的共同对应未证。
detail.en: Finite outcomes and rich answers remain premises; outcome classes, not every native ternary fact, are preserved. The witness proves the common relation can remain multivalued. Applicability to every explanation and common correspondence across different articulations remain unproved.

detail.zh: 同一规律有可区分的左／右结果；规范共同表示仍非单值，且共享后继不同于分别可行的路径。
detail.en: One law has distinguishable left/right outcomes; the canonical account remains nonfunctional, and shared continuation differs from individually feasible paths.

limitations.zh: 有限结果和丰富问答仍是前提；保持结果类而非每个原生三元事实。例子证明共同关系仍可多结果。任意解释的适用性及不同分节的共同对应未证。
limitations.en: Finite outcomes and rich answers remain premises; outcome classes, not every native ternary fact, are preserved. The witness proves the common relation can remain multivalued. Applicability to every explanation and common correspondence across different articulations remain unproved.

validation_scope.zh: 所列 Lean 源码与成功冻结回执逐字哈希绑定；本轮223项审计含26项新声明。旧功能性定理信用此前166项回执，未冒充新证明。
validation_scope.en: Listed Lean sources bind by exact hash to successful frozen receipts. This round checks 223 declarations including 26 new ones. The older functional theorem credits its previous 166-audit receipt, not a new proof.

next_delta.zh: 复用有限条件程序与真实余项恢复；继续建立内部语法不同的说明之间余项、判断与实际形成关系的有据翻译，区分语义可判定与实际取得。
next_delta.en: Reuse finite guarded programs and coherent residual recovery; establish warranted residual/guard/formation translation between descriptions with different internal syntax, distinguishing semantic tests from actual acquisition.

history.en: 2026-10-08: continued the existing joining-context study; migrated completed claims separately and distinguished new connections from reuse.

history.en: 2026-10-08 continuation: retained the original claim, premises and receipts; read the appended refinement, unanchored-collapse and retained-reference repair and updated the next connection.

history.en: 2026-10-09: reuse this result in finite-granularity continuation; preserve its claim, hypotheses and proof bindings. New prefix omission and resumption testing appear in the same study §§22–26.

history.zh: 2026-10-09接续：研究新增有限条件程序、余项恢复及35项实查声明；原成果的主张、假设和证明绑定保持，见原研究§27—32。
history.en: 2026-10-09 continuation: finite guarded programs, residual recovery and 35 checked declarations added in the same study §§27–32; this result retains its claim, assumptions and proof bindings.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。核相同且为互模拟的两描述在所用编码上一一对齐，对齐把结合的一读法带到另一读法（Joining.common_structure）。精确约化的分支解释提升结合，恰当通过相同分支检验是伙伴框架的互模拟，无有限与判定（Joining.operation_lifts_iff）。外围的 common_multivalued_structure 在脊柱上成立（Joining.common_multivalued_structure_of_em、operation_lifts_of_em），排中律作为具名假设 em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p，只用于在结果已列出时把通过相同分支检验认同为相同，即外围用经典推理之处；无此假设时，提升恰是同一编码为互模拟（Joining.operation_lifts_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Two descriptions with one kernel that is a bisimulation are aligned one to one on the codes they use, and the alignment carries one reading of the joining onto the other (Joining.common_structure). An exact reduced branch account lifts the joining exactly where passing the same branching tests is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.operation_lifts_iff). The periphery's common_multivalued_structure holds on the spine (Joining.common_multivalued_structure_of_em, operation_lifts_of_em): excluded middle is named as the hypothesis em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p and used only to identify passing the same branching tests with likeness where outcomes are listed, which is where the periphery reasoned classically; without it, lifting is exactly having one code being a bisimulation (Joining.operation_lifts_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
